## Provenance 

**Source Artifact:** 

- Arduino Kit
- LilyGo T-Display S3 development board
    - Main control chip is ESP32-S3
    - Display screen and buttons attached

## Intent & Design Idea

- **Why?:** 
    - Wanted to make a fun touch-based experience that you could directly interact with through the Arduino board

- **Design Idea:**
    - Piano Tiles minigame

## Demo

::: {style="text-align: center;"}
![](images\slideimages\pianotiles.jpg){height="550px"}
:::

## Creative Updates

- **Piano tiles game:** Vertical-scrolling rhythm game with 4 keys

- **Haptic Interaction:** Added buttons to the board for users to press and time to the music

- **Hit detection:** Visual feedback on screen to determine if user successfully hit a note or missed it. 


## Reuse & Extend

- More songs
- More keys we could add to the board
- Option to adjust falling speed of notes
- Note offset options
